cohort: Neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) of Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Medical University from October 2014 to December 2017 with suspected sepsis and positive blood cultures.
finding: Acinetobacter, Klebsiella, and Escherichia coli are the leading causes of drug-resistant bacterial sepsis in the NICU, with a high prevalence of multidrug-resistant (MDR) and extensively drug-resistant (XDR) organisms resulting in significantly higher mortality.
